start.tagline: Lost in space. Guided by you.
start.aboutBody: STARLOST is a child-friendly educational space adventure where players help LUMA find her way home by solving grid-world puzzle levels.
start.aboutThesis: The game is designed to support and assess children's spatial perspective-taking and computational thinking through movement blocks, path planning, perspective clues, and problem-solving challenges.
start.aboutCredit: STARLOST was created as part of a bachelor thesis project by Youssef Hesham Helal.

strategy.promptBody: How did you figure out which way I was facing? Pick the card that matches how you thought about it!

embody.title: I Imagined Being LUMA
embody.subtitle: Embody
embody.description: I pictured myself standing right where LUMA was, and felt which way I was facing.

rotate.title: I Rotated the Map
rotate.subtitle: Rotate
rotate.description: I spun the map around in my head until it matched the way LUMA was looking.

landmarks.title: I Used the Rocks
landmarks.subtitle: Landmarks
landmarks.description: I found the rocks and ship parts nearby to figure out which direction LUMA was facing.

crashSite.title: Crash Site
crashSite.body: LUMA has crash-landed on a strange planet. Her ship core is still glowing, but she needs your help to take her first steps and find the way home.

forestEntrance.title: Forest Entrance
forestEntrance.body: LUMA leaves the crash site and reaches a glowing alien forest. The paths twist between trees, so she must follow your directions carefully.

deepForest.title: Deep Forest
deepForest.body: The forest grows darker and trickier. LUMA must use repeated patterns, clues, and careful thinking to move deeper toward the missing ship parts.

repairSite.title: Repair Site
repairSite.body: LUMA has found the repair zone. Boxes and machinery block the way, and smarter path-checking will help her collect what the ship needs.

launchSite.title: Launch Site
launchSite.body: The ship is almost ready. Now LUMA must trace the final launch programs, reach the last target, and prepare to fly home.

level-1-welcome.title: Meet LUMA
level-1-welcome.body: This is LUMA. We help her get home.

level-1-grid.title: This is the map
level-1-grid.body: The map shows where LUMA can move.

level-1-goal.title: Here is home
level-1-goal.body: Guide LUMA to the glowing ship core.

level-1-forward.title: MOVE FORWARD
level-1-forward.body: This block makes LUMA move forward one step in the direction she is facing.

level-1-delete-clear.title: Fix your program
level-1-delete-clear.body: Use Delete to remove the last block. Use Clear to remove all blocks and start again.

level-1-shortest-path.title: Use fewer blocks
level-1-shortest-path.body: This shows your blocks compared with the shortest path. The left number is how many blocks you used. The right number is the shortest path for this level. Try to match the shortest path to get the gold medal.

level-1-luma-speed.title: Choose LUMA's speed
level-1-luma-speed.body: Use this slider to make LUMA move slower or faster when the program runs.

level-1-build-three.title: Add three MOVE FORWARD blocks
level-1-build-three.body: This level needs three tiny moves.

level-1-run.title: Press Execute Program
level-1-run.body: Now let LUMA follow your plan.

level-6-trees-block-path.title: Trees block the path
level-6-trees-block-path.body: Trees now replace rocks. They block LUMA's path too.

level-7-repeat-forward.title: Use Repeat for long repeated paths
level-7-repeat-forward.body: Instead of adding 4 MOVE FORWARD blocks, use REPEAT 4 (in this level) with MOVE FORWARD inside to move forward 4 steps. This makes the program more efficient.

level-7-blocks-inside-repeat.title: Blocks go inside Repeat
level-7-blocks-inside-repeat.body: The blocks you want to repeat are added inside the Repeat block.

level-8-repeat-then-turn.title: Turns can stay outside
level-8-repeat-then-turn.body: Some blocks stay outside Repeat when the path changes.

level-9-repeat-pattern.title: Repeat a pattern
level-9-repeat-pattern.body: Repeat can hold more than one block. Everything inside repeats in order.

level-10-repeat-fragment.title: Repeat to the fragment
level-10-repeat-fragment.body: Use Repeat to reach the fragment, then Collect.

level-11-repeat-collect-turn.title: Two small Repeat blocks
level-11-repeat-collect-turn.body: Now use two small Repeat blocks: one before collecting and one after turning.

level-15-boxes-block-path.title: Boxes block the path
level-15-boxes-block-path.body: Boxes now replace trees. They block LUMA's path too.

level-15-meet-if-path.title: Meet IF PATH
level-15-meet-if-path.body: IF PATH checks whether LUMA can move in a chosen direction. You can choose ahead, to the left, or to the right.

level-15-if-repeat.title: Use Repeat with IF PATH
level-15-if-repeat.body: Put IF PATH inside Repeat so LUMA can check a direction again and again. The dropdown helps you choose which direction LUMA checks.

level-16-same-rule-two-turns.title: Same rule, two turns
level-16-same-rule-two-turns.body: This path bends twice. Use Repeat with IF PATH to the right so LUMA turns when a side path opens.

level-17-collect-after-moving.title: Collect after moving
level-17-collect-after-moving.body: This path has ship fragments. Put COLLECT after MOVE FORWARD inside the Repeat block so LUMA collects each fragment she lands on.

level-18-if-else-command.title: New block: IF/ELSE
level-18-if-else-command.body: IF/ELSE helps LUMA choose between two actions. IF means "do this when the path is open." ELSE means "otherwise, do this instead."

level-18-two-places.title: Two parts in one block
level-18-two-places.body: This block has two spaces. Use the top part for what LUMA should do when the path is open. Use ELSE for what LUMA should do otherwise.

level-18-else-needed.title: ELSE needs a block
level-18-else-needed.body: ELSE cannot stay empty in this level. Add a block there so LUMA knows what to do when the path is blocked.

level-19-two-blocks-inside-if.title: More blocks inside IF or ELSE
level-19-two-blocks-inside-if.body: The IF and ELSE parts can hold more than one block. This lets LUMA do more than one action depending on whether the path check is true or false.

level-20-nested-if-else.title: Nested IF/ELSE blocks
level-20-nested-if-else.body: You can put an IF/ELSE block inside another IF/ELSE block. This makes LUMA check the path in 3 directions instead of 2.

level-21-trace-code.title: Trace the code
level-21-trace-code.body: This time, the program is already written for LUMA.

level-21-read-carefully.title: Read carefully
level-21-read-carefully.body: Look at the blocks and trace where LUMA will go.

level-21-choose-ending.title: Choose the ending tile
level-21-choose-ending.body: Tap the tile where you think LUMA will finish.

level-21-launch-pad.title: Find the correct tile
level-21-launch-pad.body: If you choose the correct tile, the ship core will appear and LUMA will run the program.

level-23-final-level-intro.title: Final level
level-23-final-level-intro.body: This is the final level. Solve it so LUMA can launch her fixed ship and go home.

level-23-launch-pad.title: Find the correct tile
level-23-launch-pad.body: If you choose the correct tile, the launch pad will appear and LUMA will go home.

level-1-reset.title: Need another try?
level-1-reset.body: If something goes wrong, use Reset and try again.

luma-confused-intro.title: LUMA is confused
luma-confused-intro.body: She does not know which way she is facing. Help her figure it out.

helmet-radio-intro.title: Helmet Radio
helmet-radio-intro.body: LUMA sends a clue here. Read it first.

identify-phase-intro.title: First, identify
identify-phase-intro.body: Figure out which way LUMA is facing before you plan moves.

facing-question-intro.title: Pick LUMA's direction
facing-question-intro.body: Listen to the clue and tap the LUMA picture that matches the way she is facing.

turn-commands-intro.title: Now you may need a turn
turn-commands-intro.body: MOVE FORWARD is not enough anymore. Use left or right turns too.

uncertain-radio-intro.title: This clue sounds fuzzy
uncertain-radio-intro.body: Sometimes LUMA sounds unsure. The clue may need a closer look.

visor-flip-intro.title: Try Visor Flip now!
visor-flip-intro.body: Tap Visor Flip so you can see what LUMA sees.

visor-flip-level-9-intro.title: Try Visor Flip now!
visor-flip-level-9-intro.body: Tap Visor Flip so you can see what LUMA sees.

repeat-intro.title: Repeat helps with patterns
repeat-intro.body: If you notice a path repeating, use REPEAT so LUMA can do those blocks again.

repeat-add-block.title: Add one Repeat block
repeat-add-block.body: Tap REPEAT first, then put the pattern you want inside the block.

repeat-settings.title: Tune the Repeat block
repeat-settings.body: Change the number at the top to choose how many times LUMA repeats the blocks inside.

repeat-builder-intro.title: Some blocks stay outside Repeat
repeat-builder-intro.body: Use normal blocks before or after REPEAT when the whole path is not the same.

if-path-intro.title: New block: IF PATH
if-path-intro.body: IF PATH checks whether LUMA can move in one direction.

if-path-true-false.title: Only runs when true
if-path-true-false.body: If that path is open, LUMA runs the blocks inside. If that path is blocked, she skips the inside blocks.

if-path-add.title: Add an IF block
if-path-add.body: Tap IF PATH to add the conditional block to your program.

if-path-block.title: Blocks go inside
if-path-block.body: Drag blocks into the IF block just like you do with REPEAT.

if-path-inside.title: The inside can be a pattern
if-path-inside.body: The inside can hold many blocks, and you can move them up or down.

if-path-nesting.title: IF and REPEAT can nest
if-path-nesting.body: REPEAT can go inside IF, and IF can go inside REPEAT. That helps solve Repair Site paths.

ship-fragments-intro.title: Collect ship fragments
ship-fragments-intro.body: Pick up every glowing ship piece on the map.

collect-command-intro.title: Use COLLECT on a fragment
collect-command-intro.body: When LUMA stands on a ship fragment, add COLLECT to pick it up.

collect-all-fragments-intro.title: Do not finish too early
collect-all-fragments-intro.body: Get all ship fragments before you reach the ship core.

fog-intro.title: Fog hides tiles
fog-intro.body: Now you cannot see everything. Use clues and careful planning.

prediction-intro.title: Prediction Challenge
prediction-intro.body: This box asks you to guess where LUMA will stop before you run.
